minutes.label: Focus session, minutes
minutes.description: How long a session is when the app opens. The wheel changes it in steps of five before a session starts.

break_minutes.label: Break, minutes
break_minutes.description: After a finished session Start begins a break of this length. 0: no breaks.

show_time.label: Show the time left
show_time.description: Off: the front display shows only the tree and the forest, and the time stays on the back display.

time_color.label: Color of the time
time_color.description: The color of the time left on the front display.

sound.label: Sound at the end
sound.description: Plays a sound when a session or a break ends.

keep_forest.label: Keep the forest overnight
keep_forest.description: Off: the forest starts again every day. On: every tree you ever finished stays.
